Message.Name: Sequence Reset Message
Message.Description: The Sequence Reset message is sent on each multicast channel at start of day. The client must ignore the sequence number of the Sequence Reset message itself, and set the next expected sequence number to NewSeqNo. On receipt clients must clear all cached data for all eligible instruments traded in SSE and SZSE and then subscribe to the refresh channels.

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: New sequence number. Always set to 1.

Message.Name: Disaster Recovery Signal Message
Message.Description: The Disaster Recovery (DR) Signal message is sent on a dedicated multicast channel whenever site failover is triggered.
